description: Distance between two places, in miles and kilometres, plus the compass bearing from the first to the second. Each end takes a US ZIP Code, a US ZIP+4, a Canadian FSA, a Canadian postal code, or a latitude,longitude pair, and the two ends can be different kinds — a US ZIP to a Canadian postal code works, and so does a code to a coordinate. Time zone for both ends is included. This is a straight-line distance, not a driving route. Without an API key the distance itself is returned and the geography behind it is withheld.

from.description: Origin: a ZIP Code, ZIP+4, Canadian FSA or postal code, or latitude,longitude. For example 90210, M5V 2T6, or 34.10,-118.41.

to.description: Destination, in any of the same forms as the origin.

name: distance
title: Distance between two places
